== Story 615: source-checked comparison ==
Compared the original face [[:File:Hoth-D-ewebblaster-decipher-archive.gif]] and matching later face [[:File:Hoth-D-ewebblaster.gif]]. [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 57. The revised game-text paragraph is separate from subsequent rulings; the glossary legend is on p. 2. The shared comparison includes the complete game text and distinguishes the later face stamp from the date of the underlying text. Original publication month is left unspecified. No card or GEMP identifiers were allocated. The June 2017 official Decipher Errata document, p. 15, prints singular “Your warrior present.” The PC hires image committed 5 March 2021 at 04:24 UTC prints plural “Your warriors present,” while official card data committed later that day at 18:24 UTC retains singular “warrior,” deploy 3 and forfeit 1. The same singular wording remains in the February 2023 official card-data snapshot and Appendix A. The image wording is documented as a transcription discrepancy, not an independent PC gameplay state. Partial/full images and absent sidebar figures do not create additional text states; the source cover directs use of cutouts with the original card.
